HC1.name: Business Acumen & Strategic HR Partnering
HC1.scope: Scope: Business understanding, strategic HR business partnering, workforce planning and organisation design advisory
HC1.Knowledge: Interprets Nuvoco's business model, plant economics, product line priorities and manpower cost drivers across cement, RMX and MBM, and explains how people performance links to business performance.
HC1.Skill: Analyses business and people data to diagnose workforce implications, advises leaders on organisation design, workforce planning, budgets and people priorities, and translates the AOP into HR actions with measurable people outcomes.
HC1.Attitude: Approaches people decisions with a business first mindset, stays curious about how the business works and grounds advice in evidence rather than opinion.
HC1.On-the-Job Activities:
•  Business and industry insight
•  Manpower planning and budgeting
•  Organisation structure and design advisory
•  Commercial framing of people decisions
•  Trusted advisor partnering with leaders
•  Business review and AOP participation
HC1.PL1:
• Describes Nuvoco's businesses, products and cost drivers across cement, RMX and MBM.
• Compiles manpower numbers and cost data into approved AOP templates as part of day to day work.
• Prepares headcount and attrition trackers for the assigned unit.
• Collects benchmark and talent market data from approved sources.
• Records organisation structure changes accurately for review.
HC1.PL2:
• Builds the manpower plan for an assigned unit, explains variances to the HRBP and closes monthly and quarterly plan updates independently.
• Interprets unit cost, output and productivity data when planning HR support.
• Prepares cost and benefit inputs for hiring, training and engagement proposals.
• Partners assigned line managers on routine people matters and builds working trust.
• Presents people data and insights in monthly and quarterly unit review meetings.
HC1.PL3:
• Leads annual workforce planning for the vertical and defends the manpower budget with business heads through the AOP cycle.
• Reviews structures, spans and layers prepared by the team and challenges misfit designs.
• Frames HR recommendations to leaders in commercial and return terms.
• Advises the vertical leadership team as a trusted partner on people decisions.
• Tracks the vertical people budget against the AOP and corrects overruns through the team.
HC1.PL4:
• Holds complete accountability for enterprise workforce planning and headcount governance, setting the plan with the CHRO.
• Sets the long term workforce vision and organisation design direction for Nuvoco across product lines.
• Owns the HR voice in AOP and strategy forums, reporting to the Managing Director and NLT.
• Governs manpower cost norms and reviews plans prepared by vertical heads, delivering through HRBP Heads.
• Sets the standard for evidence based, commercially framed people advice across HR.

HC2.name: Talent Acquisition
HC2.scope: Scope: Recruitment and selection, sourcing strategies, campus hiring, competency based interviewing, employer branding, candidate pre-boarding and onboarding, manpower plan alignment for hiring
HC2.Knowledge: Explains workforce requirements, job architecture, sourcing channels, assessment methods, offer structures, campus hiring and onboarding practices, and how the hiring plan connects to the manpower plan.
HC2.Skill: Sources and screens candidates, conducts competency based interviews, negotiates offers and manages hiring stakeholders to deliver diverse, quality hiring within TAT and cost targets while protecting candidate experience from attraction through induction.
HC2.Attitude: Balances speed with quality of hire and treats candidates and hiring managers with fairness and respect throughout the process.
HC2.On-the-Job Activities:
•  Sourcing strategy and channel mix
•  Screening and competency based interviews
•  Campus hiring and GET or DET intake
•  Offer negotiation and salary fitment
•  Employer branding, IJP and referrals
•  Pre-boarding, onboarding and induction
HC2.PL1:
• Coordinates interview scheduling, candidate documentation and onboarding logistics in SuccessFactors as day to day work.
• Compiles candidate trackers and TA MIS accurately and on time.
• Collects campus data and documents from selected students per criteria.
• Responds to candidate queries promptly using approved information.
• Supports induction sessions and joining formalities for new joiners.
HC2.PL2:
• Runs end to end hiring for assigned roles within TAT using approved sourcing channels and closes monthly and quarterly hiring targets independently.
• Conducts competency based screening using the funnel probing approach.
• Coordinates campus drives, panels and assessments on the ground and holds student engagement.
• Negotiates offers within approved ranges, policy and internal parity.
• Tracks pre-boarding touchpoints and flags dropout risk early with a backup ready.
HC2.PL3:
• Leads the annual hiring plan for the vertical, aligning it with the manpower plan and budget agreed in the AOP, and reviews closures, quality and cost of hire with the team.
• Reviews interview quality and coaches hiring managers on competency based interviewing.
• Owns the campus strategy for assigned institutes and the GET and DET pipeline.
• Directs vendor and agency performance for the vertical against agreed terms.
• Reviews onboarding experience using 30, 60 and 90 day feedback and closes gaps.
HC2.PL4:
• Holds complete accountability for enterprise hiring, setting the TA framework, sourcing mix and hiring governance for Nuvoco.
• Sets enterprise hiring capacity from the manpower plan, aligning long term workforce numbers, budgets and sourcing strategy with the CHRO.
• Owns hiring TAT, quality and diversity outcomes, reporting to the CHRO.
• Directs employer brand and campus positioning across product lines with a multi year view.
• Governs agency empanelment, IJP and referral standards, delivering through TA Leads and recruiters.

HC3.Knowledge: Applies knowledge of adult learning, capability frameworks and academy design.
HC3.Skill: Facilitates talent and competency assessments, succession and leadership pipeline, performance management and IDP; designs, builds and delivers organisation and capability development initiatives, talent and leadership development; and evaluates effectiveness and learning transfer for business impact to build a future-ready talent.
HC3.Attitude: Owns the learner and talent experience, invites feedback on programme quality and keeps improving design based on what works.
HC3.On-the-Job Activities:
•  Learning Solution consultancy, Training needs identification and learning calendar delivery
•  Functional academies
•  Talent review, and succession planning
•  Assessment and development centres
•  IDP, Hi-Po and leadership development programs
•  Competency architecture and competency dictionary drafting
•  Blended learning journey design using adult learning principles
•  In-house content curation, courseware and e-learning development
•  Facilitation, internal faculty development and learning partner curation
•  Learning transfer, effectiveness and business impact evaluation

• Coordinates training logistics, attendance, feedback capture and LMS records as day to day work.
• Compiles and maintains data for training needs, feedback scores, vendor data and payouts.
• Maintains talent review data, succession charts and Hi-Po tracking sheets.
• Coordinates assessment centre logistics.
• Records IDP submissions and follows up for closure.
HC3.PL2:
• Executes the learning calendar for an assigned function and closes monthly and quarterly learning hour targets independently.
• Identifies training needs with department heads and maps learning plans for individuals and teams.
• Develops in-house content, e-learning modules and facilitator material for assigned programs.
• Prepares talent assessment data and talent review packs for leadership discussions.
• Facilitates IDP exercises and supports assessment centre administration.
HC3.PL3:
• Leads the annual capability plan for the vertical per the AOP, building functional academies and drafting competency architecture from skill gap analysis.
• Designs blended learning journeys and consults department heads on capability solutions.
• Runs assessment centres, facilitates Talent Day and curates Hi-Po development programs.
• Builds succession benches for key and critical positions with the leadership team through the annual talent review.
• Reviews learning quality, application and impact for the vertical and corrects design.
HC3.PL4:
• Holds complete accountability for learning and talent outcomes, setting the enterprise learning strategy, academy structure and capability agenda across functions.
• Sets the long term talent vision, the enterprise development and IDP philosophy with the CHRO and business heads.
• Owns the talent management framework, the Hi-Po definition and succession governance for Nuvoco.
• Directs design standards for academies, assessments and development centres across functions.
• Reports learning and talent outcomes to the CHRO and NLT, delivering through L&D and TM Leads.

• Applies pay ranges and grade structures for correct fitment on hires and transfers.

HC4.PL3:

HC7.On-the-Job Activities:
